guard: Remote manager renewal accepts only the closed response for the exact captured request and atomically installs the proof plus all five credential holders before reconnect adoption
why: The response-binding mutations remove one exact coordinate check at a time. The broker-free suite supplies a still-live response from a different request and altered closed envelope coordinates, so proof stability cannot make an old response current.

The installation mutations leave one member of the five-credential family stale. The suite observes the manager field or standing holder directly for supervisor, executor, serve, goal-writer, and session-ledger, plus the installed registration proof.

The adoption mutations suppress one reconnect action at a time. The suite records endpoint reload and each direct holder reconnect independently, so validating or assigning a credential without adopting it is red.
